    if x.shape != (3,):

    rotated_quad = x @ Q @ x

    # Gaussian kernels

    sin_term = 0.1 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * (x[0] + x[1] - x[2]))

    # Combine all components, scale and shift, clip for regularization
    result = rotated_quad + gaussians + sin_term + 2.0
    result = np.clip(result, -10, 20)

    return float(result)
